headline: President Bush's 2004 order sets up a National Counterterrorism Center inside the federal government.
what_it_does: This executive order creates a National Counterterrorism Center. Based on the title, the center is a federal office focused on fighting terrorism. It most likely brings together terrorism-related information from different government agencies and helps plan counterterrorism work. No summary was provided, so the exact duties, powers, and structure are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They would likely share terrorism-related information with the new center and coordinate their counterterrorism work through it.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely upon signing on August 27, 2004; the source material does not state a date.
